senses.gloss: f. (part. pass. of גָּרַשׁ) a divorced spouse.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 112a:7">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ שנשא ג׳</he> a divorced husband who married a divorced wife.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ג׳ בחיי בעלה</he> marrying a divorced wife while her husband is yet alive.
<cite ref="Nedarim 20b:9">Ned. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>גְּרוּשַׁת הלב</he> divorced at heart, one whom her husband is determined to divorce; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גְּרוּשִׁים</he>, f. <he>גְּרוּשׁוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 268:4">Yalk. Jer. 268</cite> <he>וכי ג׳ אתם לי</he> are ye divorced from me (the Lord)?
